scope: Photo-derived diffuse visual floor material, not calibrated albedo or original lighting. Handle heavily underexposed photographs in linear light, denoise only low-light regions, remove smooth illumination/colour casts, preserve photographed tile/joint/black-accent placement and fine variation. Weak texture uses measured zero-mean stone grain. No tile-layout synthesis, uniform RGB fill or geometry/pose changes. Raw roadview and PRIME HALL source photographs remain untouched. Actual same-camera visual review is required.
